name: Stuffed Peppadews
steps: Drain peppers thoroughly and pat the cavities dry so the filling stays in place.
Mash cream cheese and vegetarian feta until smooth. Stir in finely chopped parsley, lemon zest and black pepper.
Spoon or pipe the mixture into each pepper, filling to the rim without squeezing the pepper out of shape.
Chill for 10 minutes to firm the filling, then arrange upright on a plate and serve cool.
tips: Peppadews are sweet-piquant, so taste before adding extra salt; feta already seasons the filling.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
